summary: Evaluate the existing Redl or Sauter bootstrap-current fit with an explicit method selector and named L31, L32, L34 and alpha arrays.

capability: Named neoclassical coefficients from caller-supplied trapped fraction and collisionalities.
operation: evaluate a selected bootstrap coefficient fit
trapped fraction, collisionalities and effective charge -> L31, L32, L34, alpha
discovery.model: Closed choice of the existing Redl (2021) or Sauter (1999) analytic empirical fit; each method retains its original normalization and limitations.
discovery.geometry: Caller-supplied axisymmetric tokamak face data on normalized radius rho and total flux psi (Wb); no device geometry is built in.
discovery.boundary: Coefficient evaluation only; no current assembly and no magnetic-axis zeroing are performed.

identity.relation: caller-supplied trapped fraction, collisionalities and effective charge -> L31, L32, L34 and alpha
identity.direction: Explicit face quantities to named dimensionless fit coefficients
identity.definition: For Sauter, L31/L34 use their effective trapped fractions and quartic polynomial; L32 sums the distinct ee/ei rational-polynomial fits. Redl uses its revised fits and L34=L31. Alpha=(B+a*y)/(1+c*y), y=nu_i_star^2*f_trap^6; Sauter(a,c)=(.315,.15), Redl(-.002,.004), with model-specific B. Binary exponent scaling evaluates y or 1/y without squaring overflow or logarithmic cancellation.
identity.model: Closed family of the existing Redl and Sauter bootstrap-current coefficient fits
identity.coordinates: Caller-ordered one-dimensional face arrays; rho and magnetic flux are not inputs to coefficient evaluation
identity.boundary: Coefficient evaluation only; no current assembly and no magnetic-axis zeroing are performed.
assumptions: Finite converted-binary64 input quantities; caller supplies consistent units and normalization
The Result mapping has fields in insertion order L31, L32, L34, alpha; use field names or attributes rather than positional tuple indexing or array unpacking.
The caller supplies trapped-particle fraction and collisionality in the selected fit convention; they are not reconstructed by this entry.

inputs.name: f_trap
inputs.description: Caller-supplied trapped-particle fraction, not inverse aspect ratio

inputs.name: nu_e_star
inputs.description: Caller-supplied electron collision/bounce frequency ratio under the model convention

inputs.name: Z_eff
inputs.description: Effective ionic charge for the fit
inputs.constraints: Sauter positive; Redl >=1; physical quasineutral fully ionized plasma Z_eff>=1

inputs.name: nu_i_star
inputs.description: Caller-supplied ion collision/bounce frequency ratio under the model convention

inputs.name: method
inputs.constraints: Exactly 'redl' or 'sauter'; keyword-only. These fits use the same physical inputs.

outputs.name: L31
outputs.description: Field of the returned Result mapping: dimensionless density-gradient fit coefficient on faces
outputs.constraints: Finite; equal explicit one-dimensional face shape; no broadcasting

outputs.name: L32
outputs.description: Field of the returned Result mapping: dimensionless electron-temperature coefficient correction on faces
outputs.constraints: Finite; equal explicit one-dimensional face shape; no broadcasting

outputs.name: L34
outputs.description: Ion-temperature fit coefficient in the returned Result; equal to L31 for Redl only
outputs.constraints: Finite; equal explicit one-dimensional face shape; no broadcasting

outputs.name: alpha
outputs.description: Field of the returned Result mapping: dimensionless ion temperature-gradient fit multiplier on faces
outputs.constraints: Finite; equal explicit one-dimensional face shape; no broadcasting

preconditions: Finite real one-dimensional face arrays of equal length >=2; 0<=f_trap<=1 and nonnegative nu_e_star and nu_i_star.
Z_eff>0 for sauter and Z_eff>=1 for redl; a fully ionized quasineutral plasma has Z_eff>=1.
supported: Evaluation of the selected existing coefficient fit with its method-specific applicability and evidence.
excluded: Deriving trapped fraction, collisionality, magnetic geometry or profiles; assembling bootstrap current.
General physical calibration or claims that the default is superior for every plasma.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises TypeError for a non-string method or unsupported parameter, ValueError for an unknown method or invalid physical arrays; the selected fit retains its original charge-domain and shape rejections.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError for nonfinite coefficient/current arithmetic; no fallback is returned.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; these are direct analytic fit and arithmetic mappings.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial output returned on failure.

example.description: Evaluate both existing fits with the same explicit physical inputs.
example.code:
from scirel.neoclassical import compute_bootstrap_coefficients
redl = compute_bootstrap_coefficients([0.2, 0.4], [0.1, 1.0], [1.0, 2.0], [0.1, 1.0], method='redl')
sauter = compute_bootstrap_coefficients([0.2, 0.4], [0.1, 1.0], [1.0, 2.0], [0.1, 1.0], method='sauter')
assert list(redl) == list(sauter) == ['L31', 'L32', 'L34', 'alpha']
assert redl.L31.shape == sauter.L31.shape == (2,)
example.expected: Both methods return L31, L32, L34 and alpha face arrays; selecting a method does not reconstruct physical inputs or calibrate a device.

scope: Existing per-fit numerical, extreme-scale, shape and failure regressions retained for each explicit method.
Both named methods, default selection, closed method rejection and removal of the two old public entries are directly exercised.

Primary-paper 80/120-digit fixture anchors all four coefficients at eighteen selected inputs per method, with a fixed 128*eps budget after division by max(1,abs(reference)); this is a finite arithmetic matrix, not a continuous-domain or empirical error bound.
verification.evidence_ceiling: The interface migration preserves each existing mathematical fit and its bounded regression evidence. Method-specific scope and limitations are recorded separately; selecting a fit or passing examples does not establish experimental calibration.
known_limitations: The caller must supply consistent trapped fraction and collisionality conventions.
The original fit evidence and limitations remain method-specific; no general plasma or device calibration is added.
This function does not assemble the bootstrap current or reconstruct geometry and profiles.

references: O. Sauter, C. Angioni and Y. R. Lin-Liu, Physics of Plasmas 6, 2834 (1999), doi:10.1063/1.873240.
A. Redl et al., Physics of Plasmas 28, 022502 (2021), doi:10.1063/5.0012664.

OMFIT utils_fusion, Sauter alpha implementation explicitly labeled as including the 2002 correction: https://omfit.io/_modules/omfit_classes/utils_fusion.html. The original publisher erratum was not read here.

family.name: bootstrap-coefficients
family.default_reason: Redl is the selected newer refit under the adopted family decision; this is not a universal accuracy claim. Sauter remains an explicit existing choice.

methods.name: redl
methods.model: Bounded analytic empirical tokamak fit (Redl PoP 2021 Eqs. 10-16, 19-21).

preconditions: Declared shapes, domains and matching scientific conventions; no implicit broadcasting
supported: Compute the Redl dimensionless bootstrap fit coefficients from explicit face collisionalities
excluded: Empirical coefficients are not experimentally calibrated here. Caller must supply model-consistent collisionalities and trapped fraction; no geometry reconstruction, edge pedestal or full-transport physics qualification.
Large finite charge/collisionality combinations may have nonrepresentable intermediate or final arithmetic and fail explicitly. Float64 conversion cannot recover prior lost precision.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for malformed, nonfinite, masked, mismatched or out-of-domain face inputs; no partial result.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError for nonfinite coefficient/current arithmetic; no fallback is returned.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; these are direct analytic fit and arithmetic mappings.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial output returned on failure.

scope: Redl alpha large-collisionality limit and exact L34=L31 in test_bootstrap.py; the selected test_named_result.py case checks all four ordinary coefficient baseline arrays, Result type, field order and attribute access.

The redl primary-paper fixture separately checks L31, L32, L34 and alpha at eighteen selected combinations of f_trap=0..1, nu_e_star=0..1000, Z_eff in {1,1.8,5}, and nu_i_star=0..10000; expected values come from independent 80/120-digit scalar paper expressions, not production outputs.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Mathematical fit arithmetic and explicit assembly only; no empirical full-physics qualification.
known_limitations: Empirical coefficients are not experimentally calibrated here. Caller must supply model-consistent collisionalities and trapped fraction; no geometry reconstruction, edge pedestal or full-transport physics qualification.
Large finite charge/collisionality combinations may have nonrepresentable intermediate or final arithmetic and fail explicitly. Float64 conversion cannot recover prior lost precision.

The historical Decimal claim remains unlocated. The current bound primary-paper fixture supplies new independent coefficient anchors; it does not recover that old run, estimate empirical fit error or certify the continuous parameter domain.

The 1999 author manuscript Eq.(17b) prints a negative .315 term. This API retains the selected positive corrected term, corroborated by the fixed nonzero-trapped-fraction +2.1 limit in the 2021 author paper and OMFIT corrected implementation. The original 2002 publisher erratum has not been read here.
